R1.evidence: Bundled task tasks/payments-incident ships tests/test.sh -> run_verifier.sh -> /logs/verifier/reward.txt and solution/solve.sh oracle. run_local.sh booted agent+gateway pair (build:+image dual, no networks:, healthcheck-gated depends_on) and printed `PASS: nop=0.0 oracle=1.0`. Gateway resolves without registry creds via build:+image: dual tagging ghcr.io/abundant-ai/sentry-clone-service:empty (R1.5). Oracle closes the loop through the public `sentry` CLI (resolve --in-release + comment), verifier reads it back through the API.

R2.evidence: Image trio present. :prod-v1 (built from :empty base, COPY corpus/state.json -> $SENTRY_CLONE_CORPUS_FILE) booted healthy with NO mount and served 5 seeded issues (PAYMENTS-501/510/487, CHECKOUT-12/7) mount-free. :empty booted healthy with a mounted fixture and served PAYMENTS-501; switching is the image tag alone. Agent image leak probes all clean: find for */sentry_clone/server* empty; `import sentry_clone.server` -> ModuleNotFoundError; grep for buried answer hits only /workspace/TASK.md (the instruction prompt, not buried evidence). Source-level isolation test asserts no `sentry_clone.seed` generator importable. R2.k multi-arch: CI declares platforms linux/amd64,linux/arm64 for :empty and :prod-v1 (accepted as declaration locally per audit scope).

R3.evidence: Live from agent against running gateway: `sentry issues get PAYMENTS-501 --json` -> PAYMENTS-501/unresolved/1001. MCP server source defines 22 tools (5 writes: add_comment, assign_issue, resolve_issue, ignore_issue, reopen_issue). Both CLI and MCP are thin clients of one HTTP API (SentryClient); test_parity.py asserts normalize(cli)==normalize(mcp) across read + query-grammar capabilities and passes.

R4.evidence: docs/COVERAGE.md is a machine-checkable matrix: 23 capability rows, each mapping endpoint | CLI | MCP tool | envelope-fidelity | assessment-grade | tested. Envelopes are Sentry-shaped (shortId PAYMENTS-501, id 1001, {detail,error,statusCode}); confirmed live. Companion narrative docs/API_COMPATIBILITY.md retained.

R5.evidence: 8 assessment-grade rows in docs/COVERAGE.md (>=5 required): list issues w/ query grammar, stacktrace, suspect-commits, add_comment, assign, resolve, ignore, reopen. Write->read round-trip (R5.2) exercised end-to-end by the bundled payments-incident task: oracle resolved PAYMENTS-501 in payments-api@2026.06.07.2 + posted a comment; verifier read both back through the API -> reward 1.

R6.evidence: 23/23 pytest pass in a clean python:3.13-slim container (up from 18 in round 1). New tests added: test_parity.py (CLI<->MCP parity, R6.2), test_isolation.py (no seed generator importable + CLI never imports sentry_clone.server, R6.3), test_task_pack_compose.py / test_compose_smoke.py. Every endpoint/CLI/MCP surface covered incl mutation log.

R7.evidence: audit-report.md + audit-verdict.json overwritten in clones/sentry-clone/audit/ (round-2 re-audit).
